novel_features.name: Seat and limit utilization
novel_features.description: From the synced mirror (run sync first): each client domain's users, call queues, auto attendants and conferences against their limits, plus device, number, call and SMS counts, with over-limit and near-limit domains flagged and a flat true-up CSV.

novel_features.name: Registration health sweep
novel_features.description: From the synced mirror (run sync first): phones and softphones that are unregistered, expired, high-latency, never provisioned or not provisioned recently, sorted by client.

novel_features.name: DID routing audit
novel_features.description: From the synced mirror (run sync first): where every phone number routes, flagging numbers whose target is missing for that routing type, disabled or parked numbers, unverifiable targets, and possible dead ends (a user with no registered phone and voicemail off; answer rules are not inspected).

novel_features.name: E911 gap report
novel_features.description: From the synced mirror (run sync first): domains, users and devices with no emergency caller ID after inheritance, or with an emergency address ID that does not exist. A data-gap check to feed a Kari's Law / RAY BAUM's Act review, not a full compliance test.

novel_features.name: Identifier trace
novel_features.description: From the synced mirror (run sync first): resolve one phone number, extension, MAC address or email to its client, routing, user, and the user's phones with their registration state.

novel_features.name: Missed direct calls
novel_features.description: Live (needs the API key): unanswered inbound calls per user and client over a window, read from CDRs; adds names and registered-phone counts when users and devices are synced.

novel_features.name: Queue abandonment and staffing
novel_features.description: Live (needs the API key): call queues across clients ranked by abandonment rate, with service level, available agents and agents whose phones are not registered. Checks up to --max-domains (25) domains and reports when it was capped.

novel_features.name: Change log since baseline
novel_features.description: From the synced mirror: users, devices, numbers and domains added, removed or re-pointed since the baseline. Read-only; record or move the baseline with --rebaseline.
